svg.title: Lee–Wang shrinker approaching its cone
svg.desc: Four exact real slices at times −1, −0.25, −0.04 and 0, shown at the same scale. Orange marks the shrinking waist. The full flow has dimension three in R6; these surfaces do not flow by their own mean curvature.

g.text: A shrinking waist, a noncompact cone
Exact s = 0 slices · n = 3, k = 2 · x₁² + x₂² − x₃² = −2t
Same camera and spatial scale; cropped to |X| ≤ 3.6 at every time.
A 2D slice of a 3-manifold in C³, not a surface MCF in R³. Lee–Wang, Theorem 1.1.
